AWJimage 1.3.1 - unmodified standalone image-conversion backend
Copyright: AWJimage contributors (see NOTICE.txt and source).
License: GNU Affero General Public License, version 3; see LICENSE.
VS Player invokes AWJ.com through command-line arguments; no AWJ source is linked into VS Player.

Upstream: https://github.com/Dominic485649/AWJimage
Release: https://github.com/Dominic485649/AWJimage/releases/tag/1.3.1
Source revision: 32713a1249afaabe52b85959c57097cf17770e76
Corresponding source is provided alongside these binaries as runtime/awj-source/AWJimage-1.3.1-source.zip.
The upstream CMakePresets.json, vcpkg.json, vcpkg-overlays, scripts, licenses,
README and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES document building and obtaining pinned codec dependencies.
AVX2 is required by this upstream Windows build. Image viewing does not require this backend.

Native conversion: libavif/AOM, libwebp, libjxl, JPEGli, libpng.
GPU acceleration applies to visual-quality metrics, not codec encoding/decoding.
AWJ_Win.7z SHA256: 5b4d2a16f7d6f7c74c84b23f88c088b77a9244671316a31dcd7826da8a74f865

Only the independent AWJ.com CLI is shipped, compressed in runtime/awj.7z.
AWJ.exe GUI is not used or distributed. Upstream LICENSE and NOTICE.txt are preserved.

Corresponding source archive SHA256: 82a33e3f54acaca830c37d03d3c671a0728473250e21b529030c44b4e4697124
